title: Number wall pops when notifications arrive
body:
I've tried the "Number wall on lock screen" option recently and disabled it soon after. Since then, I'm still having the number wall popping (with a black background) when the phone is locked and a new notification arrives (which wakes up the phone for a few seconds). I've updated my wallpapers (both for home and lock screens) in the android options but it didn't change anything.

My phone is a Pixel 5a with Android 12 and I'm using the latest xDrip from the Nightly update channel.

comments.body: I can see the same thing.
@tolot27 This is display-related.  What label should I use?
@jamorham How can one remove the image, after disabling this, so that the phone behaves as it did before?

Please enable the Number wall on lock screen again.
Click on Configure Number wall and delete the image.
Then, disable the number wall again.
The image should not show up any longer when screen locked.

Please explain if you still see unexpected behavior.
There was no image to delete. I tried to enable/disable and it didn't change anything either.

I may have misunderstood the problem then.
What did you mean by the following?

> I'm still having the number wall popping

Here is a gif showing what happens when I receive an email notification for instance. The phone turns on and shows a black screen with the number wall on it, and then my usual background appears.

![gif](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/34622676/158288619-4b50628e-878d-479d-943a-f7e0f82d278b.gif)

> with the number wall on it

What is "number wall" in that?

The number 54?  
The arrow?
You don't mean the time or temperature, do you?
Or, do you mean the email notification itself?
It's the number 54 and the arrow (it's called "number wall" in the xdrip settings).
@marciogranzotto Any idea what could be happening here?
Is xDrip enabled in android accessibility settings for Always On Display?

I disabled "Use xDrip+" under the menu Accessibility > xDrip+ and the problem seems to be solved!
![Screenshot_20220526-151933](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/34622676/170589329-b2baa886-fad1-405f-84f6-c49bb2d1f6dc.png)
